neighbours.label: Word-initial ana-/Ana- sequences, especially in analogue, analysing/analytical, and Anabaptist words.
fire: At the design conference, an analogue installation translated visitors' movements into shifting patterns of light.
Inside the recording studio, the engineer preferred analogue equipment for the warmth of its sound.
According to the protocol, analytical methods should detect small changes in the concentration of dissolved minerals.
The hiring panel valued her analytical approach to comparing budgets across several departments.
Before recommending a fertilizer, the researcher began analysing the nutrients present in each soil sample.
The editor requested a detailed analysis of how the novel portrays loyalty during wartime.
The historian traced the spread of Anabaptism through small communities along the river.
In the seminar, students debated why Anabaptists rejected infant baptism despite pressure from local authorities.
quiet: Visitors at the design conference watched a physical installation translate their movements into shifting patterns of light.
For the warmth of its sound, the recording engineer preferred tape equipment inside the studio.
Under the protocol, measurement methods should detect small changes in the concentration of dissolved minerals.
When comparing budgets across several departments, the hiring panel valued her methodical approach.
To choose a fertilizer, the researcher began examining the nutrients present in each soil sample.
In reviewing the novel, the editor requested a detailed examination of its portrayal of loyalty during wartime.
Along the river, the historian traced the spread of religious reform through small communities.
During their seminar, students debated why religious dissenters rejected infant baptism despite pressure from local authorities.
